source: Current production content files for DEUTSCH Memory Trainer

verbs.json.notes: Verb forms, tense examples and Arabic translations were reviewed in previous content passes.

nouns.json.notes: Articles, plural forms, examples and Arabic translations were reviewed.

adjectives.json.notes: Meanings, examples and supported comparison training were reviewed.

phrases.json.notes: Production phrase content remains at 297 items.

other-vocabulary.json.notes: Template examples were replaced with contextual German sentences and accurate Arabic translations.

notes: Production content is stored in five separate JSON files.
Existing IDs must never be changed because user progress, favorites and daily study sets depend on them.
Generic template examples such as 'Das Wort ... bedeutet auf Arabisch ...' are not accepted as final learning examples.
German examples and Arabic translations must remain semantically aligned.
Counts in this manifest reflect the current approved project state: 269 verbs, 524 nouns, 180 adjectives, 297 phrases and 151 other vocabulary items.
Full application validation must be run inside the project repository before deployment.
